title: SpongeBob Cosmic Odyssey
description: SpongeBob SquarePants stands on the edge of a surreal cliff face shaped like a giant mustached face with glowing eyes, holding a glowing staff. A green dog-like creature stands beside him as winged angelic figures and ethereal goddesses float in a vibrant swirling cosmic vortex filled with stars, planets, and a distant waterfall.
prompt: SpongeBob SquarePants standing on the edge of a giant cliff shaped like a smiling mustached face with glowing multicolored eyes, holding a glowing staff next to a small green dog-like creature, surrounded by floating ethereal goddesses in pink dresses with wings and a large central angelic warrior woman with golden wings holding a trident, all set against a swirling cosmic vortex of stars, galaxies, and nebulae with a bright sun and waterfall in the background, highly detailed surreal fantasy scene
